public_rationale: Marcus said the system “appears to depend heavily” on synthetic data. The qualification matters: he offered a tentative impression, not an unqualified assertion of heavy reliance. The rules exclude scoring such hedged assessments and reserve plain-reading scoring for firm claims. Testing actual heavy reliance would repeat the reviewers' objection by strengthening his statement. This disposition neither endorses nor rejects the underlying possibility.
limitations: This assessment does not determine how much synthetic data o1 used or how important that data was.

our_interpretation: The new system refers to the o1 system discussed at its September 12, 2024 launch.
“Appears” qualifies the assertion as a tentative impression. It does not commit Marcus to established heavy reliance.
“Heavily” supplies no measure of data quantity or dependence. Scoring actual heavy reliance would strengthen his words.
The separate suggestion about differences between domains is outside the supplied normalized proposition.

criteria.contradiction_condition: No binary contradiction condition fairly applies under the stated rules: evidence against actual reliance would not by itself falsify the qualified statement about how the system appeared.
